name: GIN-Wallpaper-Calend
description: Smart Desktop Wallpaper with Calendar for Windows 10/11 (Single user desktop shortcut, dedicated Go 386 uninstaller with self-cleanup, universal 32/64-bit architecture)
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev
features: Single User Desktop Shortcut: creates strictly ONE shortcut on the active user's desktop, purges Public Desktop duplicates
Dedicated Robust Uninstaller: completely cleans program directory, temp artifacts, registry keys, and shortcuts
Universal 32-bit & 64-bit Architecture: runs natively on Windows 10/11 (x86 and x64) via Intel 80386 PE32 standard and WOW64
Streamlined Installer Footprint: installer reduced by ~60% (5.5 MB vs 13.7 MB) via transparent gzip payload streaming
Win32 API Dynamic Fallback: native support for 32-bit user32.dll SetWindowLongW with safe signed pointer offsets
Custom & Relocated Pictures Directory: auto-detects D:\docs\Pictures, Windows Registry User Shell Folders, and Shell APIs
Clickable Status Link: clicking '✓ Сохранено в Pictures: <file>' instantly opens Windows Explorer and highlights the newly saved image (/select,<path>)
Official Wallhaven 4K API source with 14 curated categories (Trucks & Jeeps, Girls/Fashion portraits, 3D, Nature, etc.)
Full trilingual EN/CS/RU localization, minimal installer, silent uninstaller, and ~1.5-2 MB idle RAM consumption
